data.title: 德尔塔 · 溪涧跃水的丰收欢呼
data.description: 清凉的山涧溪流中水花四溅。德尔塔光着脚丫站在滑溜溜的溪石上，双手高高举着刚徒手抓到的大青鱼，狼耳竖得笔直，蓬松的大尾巴在身后疯狂摇摆，兴奋地向老大邀功：“老大看！德尔塔抓到了！！”
data.location: sunlit forest mountain stream with cascading water rapids and smooth river rocks
data.action: standing in churning river water, triumphantly holding a large splashing freshwater fish overhead with both hands, wolf ears perked, tail wagging excitedly
data.lighting: sparkling morning sun filtering through lush green canopy creating dancing caustic reflections
data.mood: explosive animal joy, unbridled hunting triumph, pure devoted loyalty
data.promptProse: Delta in a leopard bikini splashes through a forest river stream, proudly lifting a giant caught fish over her head with perked wolf ears.
data.animaCaption: Delta proudly holding up a freshly caught fish in a sparkling mountain river.
